courses.title: The Love That Remains Healing Companion
courses.description: A home-study kit from Lisa for people grieving someone they love. It brings together five guided meditations, a daily energy-reset routine, a chakra toolkit for grief and a printable journal for noting signs from the person who has died, framed around staying connected to them at the soul level.

flags: Price not shown on the page itself; the buy button goes to a ThriveCart checkout (drlisathompson.thrivecart.com), whose robots.txt answered 403, so it was not opened. The old plan's $47 could not be confirmed, so 'Contact for pricing' is used.
Page talks of lifting the weight of grief and calming the nervous system: emotional healing, allowed under the new rule; no medical claim.
